gloss: seal box; space for a stamp on a form

definitions.gloss: seal column; box for affixing a personal seal
definitions.explanation: The small marked space on a form or contract where a personal seal is to be stamped. Found on applications, delivery slips, and official paperwork.

examples.japanese: {捺印欄|なついんらん}が{空|あ}いています。
examples.english: The seal box has been left blank.

examples.japanese: {右下|みぎした}の{捺印欄|なついんらん}に{印|いん}を{押|お}してください。
examples.english: Please stamp your seal in the box at the bottom right.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{捺印欄|なついんらん}のない{書類|しょるい}が{増|ふ}え、{電子|でんし}{署名|しょめい}で{済|す}むようになった。
examples.english: Recently more documents have no seal box, and an electronic signature is enough.

notes:
{捺印|なついん} (affixing a seal) + {欄|らん} (column, field on a form). Part of a family of form-field words built with {欄|らん}, such as {署名欄|しょめいらん} and {記入欄|きにゅうらん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}に{押|お}す: to stamp in the seal box
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}が{空白|くうはく}: the seal box is blank
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}を{設|もう}ける: to provide a seal box

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}: signature field — for a handwritten name instead of a seal
- {記入欄|きにゅうらん}: entry field — any blank to be filled in
